Website information

about what you’re seeing.

About SkipManual

SkipManual designs and builds professional websites for local businesses. The current base website package is $249 per month, in US dollars. Scope and full contractual terms are confirmed before an agreement.

Original example concepts

Current Electric, Ridgeline Roofing, Clearflow Plumbing, Form Studio, and Olive & Ember are fictional businesses created for these examples. Their names, copy, services, menu items, class schedules, and forms are illustrative. They are not client projects and do not represent real business results.

Photography

Photographs show the work and settings relevant to each example. Sourced images do not represent SkipManual clients, employees, facilities, or completed client projects. No affiliation with the photographers or photographed businesses is implied.
